## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. Include native screenshots or a short clip for
UI changes. State anything you could not test.

- [ ] Kept the change focused and updated installation defaults where needed.
- [ ] Excluded private data, credentials, caches and generated outputs.
- [ ] Preserved licenses and documented sources for new bundled assets.
